neighbours.label: a degree adverb of completeness or scale ('fully', 'massively') modifying the next adjective or participle ('fully furnished', 'massively multiplayer'), as against the same descriptions without the adverb or with the adjective 'full'
fire: The cottage is let fully equipped, with linen, towels and a modern kitchen.
The studio released a massively popular online shooter last spring.
Our clinic is fully accredited and open to new patients every weekday.

All of our electricians are fully qualified and carry valid licences.
The museum now offers a fully guided tour in five different languages.
Critics called it a massively ambitious project for such a small team.
